[folded SR-14.9.39.3-L7.3 = §14.9.39.3 12) c) 3.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB451 — WAS DIVERGES, the reachable-and-unchecked case whose harm was a Roslyn CS0030 on GENERATED user source; CLOSED. Rule: `cite.py --check 14.9.39.3 "if the data item referenced by identifier-3 is described without a FACTORY phrase, the method containing the SET statement shall be defined in the instance definition of its containing class"` -> OK 12) (SR12 c)3.). DERIVED: inside a FACTORY method SELF is the class's FACTORY object, and a receiver described with a bare object-class-name holds an INSTANCE object (SS13.18.60.4 GR22 d)1.b.), so the statement shall be rejected AT BIND, citing this rule against the SET statement's own source line - the exact twin of the SR10 d) message the interface leg already emitted. OBSERVED: `error COBOL0867: SET 'R' TO SELF: the receiving item is described without the FACTORY phrase, so the method containing the SET statement shall be defined in the instance definition of its containing class (ISO SS14.9.39.3 SR12c3)`, identically at 2002, 2014 and 2023. The fixture SATISFIES c)2. deliberately (the containing class IS the receiver's class), so the class-relation test cannot be what rejects it. The CONFORMING twin runs: the MK method of pb451_set_format5_self_sender does the same SET in an INSTANCE method and prints WHO-P. The prior measurement (`CS0030: Cannot convert type 'CC3__FACTORY' to 'CC3'`) no longer reproduces: PB389 replaced the SELF arm's two-arm class/interface split with a four-arm switch over the receiver's ObjectRefKind, and ONE placement predicate (`rd.Factory != host.OoInFactory`) serves c)3., c)4. and SR14 b)1./b)2., which is why L7.4, L8.1 and L8.2 close with it.

[folded SR-14.9.39.3-L7.4 = §14.9.39.3 12) c) 4.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB451 — WAS NOT-IMPLEMENTED, with no code AND no writable subject (a FACTORY-OF receiver was loud-staged COBOL0899); CLOSED. Rule: `cite.py --check 14.9.39.3 "if the data item referenced by identifier-3 is described with a FACTORY phrase, the method containing the SET statement shall be defined in the factory definition of its containing class"` -> OK 12) (SR12 c)4.). DERIVED: the mirror of c)3. - inside an INSTANCE method SELF is an instance object, and a FACTORY-described receiver holds the class's factory object (SS13.18.60.4 GR22 d)1.a.), two different objects of two different method interfaces (SS9.3.6) - so the statement is refused at bind. OBSERVED: `error COBOL0867: SET 'R' TO SELF: the receiving item is described with the FACTORY phrase, so the method containing the SET statement shall be defined in the factory definition of its containing class (ISO SS14.9.39.3 SR12c4)` at 2002/2014/2023. The CONFORMING direction runs: FMK in pb451_set_format5_self_sender declares `01 FR ... FACTORY OF PB451P.`, does SET FR TO SELF inside a FACTORY method and INVOKEs the factory roster -> FTAG-P. The note's prediction that 'it becomes reachable the moment the FACTORY-OF wave lands, and it must be implemented TOGETHER with c)3. as one placement predicate' is what happened: PB389's landing made the receiver writable and the ONE predicate serves both.
